title: CNC — SPC
description: Statistical process control on the milled diameter: I-MR charts, capability, and what the diameter correlates with.

links.title: CNC drill-down
links.tooltip: State, OEE, faults and process parameters for this machine

list.name: machine
list.label: Machine
list.query:
SELECT subltree(l.path, nlevel(l.path) - 2, nlevel(l.path))::text AS __text,
       l.path::text AS __value
FROM umh.location l
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
WHERE g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
GROUP BY l.path
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cp
panels.description: Spec width over the process spread: (USL-LSL)/(6 sigma). It ignores where the process sits, so Cp stays high while the tool wears the mean off centre. Sigma is the moving-range estimate, mR/1.128, not the sample standard deviation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'part_count'   THEN v.value_num END) AS part,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'measurement' AND g.name = 'diameter_mm'  THEN v.value_num END) AS dia,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'life_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_life,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
),
mr AS (
  SELECT part, ts, dia, abs(dia - lag(dia) OVER (ORDER BY part)) AS range
  FROM p
),
lim AS (
  SELECT avg(dia) AS mu,
         avg(range) AS mrbar,
         avg(range) / 1.128 AS sigma,
         count(*) AS n
  FROM mr
)
SELECT (25.05 - 24.95) / (6 * sigma) AS value FROM lim

panels.title: Cpk
panels.description: Capability against the nearer spec limit. This is the one that falls as the tool wears the diameter toward the upper limit. Below 1.00 the process is producing out-of-spec parts.

panels.title: Diameter per part — individuals chart
panels.description: One point per finished part. Solid grey is the process mean, dashed grey the 3-sigma control limits (what the process does), dashed red the specification limits (what the drawing demands). Control limits inside the spec limits is the whole point of capability.

p AS (

  FROM s

  ORDER BY part, ts

SELECT p.ts AS "time", p.dia AS "diameter",

FROM p, lim
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Machine state, same time axis
panels.description: Read this against the chart above: a step in the diameter that lines up with a tool change is wear being reset, while an excursion during setup or a fault is a different story.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.ts AS "time",
       CASE v.value_num::int
            WHEN 0   THEN 'idle'
            WHEN 10  THEN 'running'
            WHEN 20  THEN 'setup'
            WHEN 30  THEN 'FAULT'
            WHEN 40  THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN 70  THEN 'tool change'
            ELSE 'code ' || v.value_num::int::text END AS "state"
FROM umh.value_cnc v
  JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
  JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
  AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
  AND g.virtual_path = '' AND g.name = 'state'
  AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Moving range
panels.description: The part-to-part change. This is what sigma is estimated from, and a point above its UCL means the process jumped rather than drifted -- a tool change, a new batch of material, an operator intervention.

p AS (

panels.title: Deviation from nominal per tool-life band
panels.description: Bar height is how far the mean diameter of that band sits above nominal, in micrometres; the dashed line is the 50 um tolerance. A fresh tool is 100%, so the bars should climb from right to left as the tool wears. Hover for how many parts a band holds -- the thin ones are the noisy ones.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'part_count'   THEN v.value_num END) AS part,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'measurement' AND g.name = 'diameter_mm'  THEN v.value_num END) AS dia,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'life_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_life,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
),
b AS (
  SELECT width_bucket(tool_life, 0, 100, 10) AS bucket, dia
  FROM p WHERE tool_life IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (0 + (bucket - 1) * 10)::text || '-'
       || (0 + bucket * 10)::text || ' %' AS "tool life",
       avg(dia - 25.0) * 1000 AS "mean deviation",
       count(*) AS "parts"
FROM b
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

panels.description: Load rises as the tool wears, so this climbs too -- through tool wear, not because load moves the diameter. Correlation on this board is not a causal claim.

         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
),
b AS (
  SELECT width_bucket(load_pct, 40, 100, 6) AS bucket, dia
  FROM p WHERE load_pct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (40 + (bucket - 1) * 10)::text || '-'
       || (40 + bucket * 10)::text || ' %' AS "spindle load",
       avg(dia - 25.0) * 1000 AS "mean deviation",
       count(*) AS "parts"
FROM b
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Deviation from nominal per coolant-pressure band
panels.description: The control case. Coolant pressure is a deliberately capable, stable process, so these bars should be flat. If they ever slope, something changed in the machine rather than in the tool.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'part_count'   THEN v.value_num END) AS part,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'measurement' AND g.name = 'diameter_mm'  THEN v.value_num END) AS dia,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'life_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_life,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
),
b AS (
  SELECT width_bucket(pressure, 4.2, 4.8, 5) AS bucket, dia
  FROM p WHERE pressure IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (4.2 + (bucket - 1) * 0.1)::text || '-'
       || (4.2 + bucket * 0.1)::text || ' bar' AS "coolant pressure",
       avg(dia - 25.0) * 1000 AS "mean deviation",
       count(*) AS "parts"
FROM b
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Out-of-spec parts, with the conditions that made them
panels.description: Every part outside tolerance, newest first, with the process values at the moment it was measured. This is where a correlation becomes a diagnosis: the same tool number and a high tool-life reading on every row points at the tool, not the machine.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'part_count'   THEN v.value_num END) AS part,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'measurement' AND g.name = 'diameter_mm'  THEN v.value_num END) AS dia,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'life_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_life,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
)
SELECT ts AS "time", part::int AS "part",
       dia AS "diameter", (dia - 25.0) AS "deviation",
       tool_no::int AS "tool", tool_life::int AS "tool life %",
       load_pct AS "spindle load %", pressure AS "coolant bar",
       CASE state::int WHEN 10 THEN 'running' WHEN 70 THEN 'tool change'
                       WHEN 20 THEN 'setup' WHEN 30 THEN 'FAULT'
                       WHEN 40 THEN 'stopped' ELSE 'code ' || state::int::text END AS "state"
FROM p
WHERE dia > 25.05 OR dia < 24.95
ORDER BY ts DESC

panels.title: Per tool
panels.description: The same parts grouped by tool number: how many parts each tool made, where it centred, and its own Cpk. A single bad tool shows up here and nowhere else.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', v.ts) AS ts,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'part_count'   THEN v.value_num END) AS part,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'measurement' AND g.name = 'diameter_mm'  THEN v.value_num END) AS dia,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'life_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_life,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'tool'        AND g.name = 'number'       THEN v.value_num END) AS tool_no,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'load_pct'     THEN v.value_num END) AS load_pct,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'spindle'     AND g.name = 'temp_c'       THEN v.value_num END) AS temp_c,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = 'coolant'     AND g.name = 'pressure_bar' THEN v.value_num END) AS pressure,
         max(CASE WHEN g.virtual_path = ''            AND g.name = 'state'        THEN v.value_num END) AS state
  FROM umh.value_cnc v
    JOIN umh.topic t ON t.topic_id = v.topic_id
    JOIN umh.tag g ON g.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN umh.location l ON l.location_id = t.location_id
  WHERE l.path = ANY(ARRAY[${machine:sqlstring}]::ltree[])
    AND g.data_contract_name = '_cnc'
    AND $__timeFilter(v.ts)
  GROUP BY 1
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (part) part, ts, dia, tool_life, tool_no, load_pct, temp_c, pressure, state
  FROM s
  WHERE part IS NOT NULL AND dia IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY part, ts
),
mr AS (
  SELECT part, ts, dia, abs(dia - lag(dia) OVER (ORDER BY part)) AS range
  FROM p
),
lim AS (
  SELECT avg(dia) AS mu,
         avg(range) AS mrbar,
         avg(range) / 1.128 AS sigma,
         count(*) AS n
  FROM mr
)
SELECT p.tool_no::int AS "tool",
       count(*) AS "parts",
       round(avg(p.dia)::numeric, 4) AS "mean",
       round(min(p.dia)::numeric, 4) AS "min",
       round(max(p.dia)::numeric, 4) AS "max",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.dia > 25.05 OR p.dia < 24.95) AS "out of spec",
       round((least(25.05 - avg(p.dia), avg(p.dia) - 24.95)
              / (3 * max(lim.sigma)))::numeric, 2) AS "Cpk"
FROM p, lim
GROUP BY p.tool_no
ORDER BY 1
